definitions.explanation: A formal notice or report submitted to authorities or an organization, often required by law or regulations.

examples.japanese: {転居届出|てんきょとどけで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I submitted a change of address notification to city hall.

examples.japanese: {届出|とどけで}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If notification is required, please complete the procedure early.

examples.japanese: {届出|とどけで}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧です。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{届|とどけ} (notification) + {出|で} (submission)

COMMON TYPES OF {届出|とどけで}:
- {婚姻届出|こんいんとどけで} - marriage registration
- {出生届出|しゅっせいとどけで} - birth registration
- {転居届出|てんきょとどけで} - change of address notification
- {死亡届出|しぼうとどけで} - death registration
- {開業届出|かいぎょうとどけで} - business registration
- {退職届出|たいしょくとどけで} - resignation notice

FORMS:
- {届|とどけ} - shorter form, used similarly
- {届|とど}け{出|で} - alternative spelling

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届出|とどけで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to submit a notification
- {届出|とどけで}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧ - to accept a registration
- {届出|とどけで}⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧ - notification documents
- {届出|とどけで}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ - obligation to report

LEGAL CONTEXT:
Many {届出|とどけで} are legally required in Japan for life events, business activities, and regulatory compliance.
